tools.name: find_place
tools.description:
Look up what a place name means in the Swiss public-transport network: stations and stops, street addresses, and named places (a university, a museum, a mountain), ranked best first, each with a stable place_id.

Use it when the user names a place you are not sure of, when another tool answered that

tools.name: plan_journey
tools.description:
Find the best connections by train, tram, bus, boat and mountain railway between two places in Switzerland, over the official Swiss timetable. Door to door: an address or a named place works as well as a station, and the walk to and from the nearest stops is included.

Use it for "how do I get from

tools.name: departures
tools.description:
List the next departures from one station or stop, as the board on the platform would: time, line, direction, platform, kind of vehicle, and the next stops it calls at.

Use it for "what leaves from Bern in the next hour", "when is the next tram from Bellevue", or to see how often a place is served.

tools.name: plan_day_out
tools.description:
Plans a multi-stop day with a stay at each stop, timing each leg from when the previous stay ends: the train there, the hours somewhere, the connection on, and the way home.

Use it for "a day trip from Bern to Grindelwald with four hours hiking, then dinner in Interlaken", "visit Thun, Spiez and In

tools.name: reachable_area
tools.description:
List every station and stop in Switzerland reachable from one place within a number of minutes by public transport, nearest first, with the earliest arrival at each.

Use it for "where can I get to from Bern in 45 minutes", "which towns are within an hour's commute of Zug", catchment areas and isoch

tools.name: travel_time_matrix
tools.description: Compute the public-transport travel time in minutes from each of several origins to each of several destinations in Switzerland, for one departure time. For comparing locations: which office site is best reached from where staff live, which flat has the shortest commutes, how well a venue is connect
